name: AI News Video
tagline: Builds a two-minute narrated explainer video from your AI news brief, figures checked
description: Feed it your AI news brief and it comes back as a narrated explainer of about two minutes. Every number in the script is checked against the original source before the voiceover is recorded. The result is ready to publish as a short video without a production team.
